title: Unlimiformer: Long-Range Transformers with Unlimited Length Input
layout_note: Left half: chunking and encoding feeding an index; right half: one decoder layer; the two halves are joined by a retrieval loop of curved arrows rather than by a straight pipeline.
grouping: Two regions without frames: on the left the long input is chunked and encoded into an index (bottom to top); on the right a single decoder layer is drawn as a white rounded frame containing its cross-attention box. A loop of curved arrows links them across the top: query -> kNN Search -> index -> Retrieved hidden states -> cross attention.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin outlines, colour-coded by role: cream token cells (a-f) for the input and its chunks, white Encoder box, lavender 'Index of one long input', pale green 'query' and 'Retrieved hidden states', light blue 'Cross attention'. Tokens in each chunk that serve only as context have dashed outlines and no fill. Curly braces group the input into pairs, dotted arrows lift each pair to its chunk. Connectors are smooth black curves; the kNN Search label is set in italic math k. Tokens use a serif face, boxes a sans face.
proposed_highlight: The retrieval path is the only green in the figure and the hooked-in cross-attention is the only blue box; the rest of the decoder layer is an empty white frame.
lesson: To show where retrieval enters a model, draw just one layer as an empty frame with the hooked sub-block tinted, and run the query -> index -> retrieved loop in its own colour, with overlapping input chunks whose context-only tokens are dashed.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF's first page (NeurIPS 2023). The crop tool found no 'Figure 1' caption in the PDF; Figure 2 is the paper's method diagram.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a purple 'Index of one long input' bar across the top left, built by the encoder below it, from which a green query -> kNN search -> retrieved hidden states loop of curved arrows runs to the cross-attention box inside one decoder layer at the right

relations.form: the input token row a-f at the bottom is split by braces into overlapping chunks, drawn as three token rows above it where the context-only tokens are dashed-outline and the encoded tokens solid
bottom to top on the left: input row -> overlapping chunks -> Encoder -> three arrows into the index bar
the retrieved hidden states enter the blue Cross attention box from the side while the decoder's own stream passes through it bottom to top
only one decoder layer is drawn, as an empty white frame whose sole content is the hooked cross-attention box

channels.colour: yellow = input tokens, purple = the index (datastore), green = the retrieval path labels (query, retrieved hidden states), blue = the modified cross-attention; one meaning each
channels.shape: rectangles throughout; token cells are small squares, modules rounded boxes
channels.line: dotted arrows = chunking (input to chunk rows), solid curved arrows = encoding and the retrieval loop; dashed cell outlines = context-only tokens
channels.frame: one rounded frame marks a single decoder layer

quality.strengths: The datastore is a distinct purple bar beside the encoding flow and the retrieved states are drawn as their own green item, matching the retrieval form; overlapping chunks are drawn on real token letters with dashed context tokens; the decoder layer is reduced to the one sub-block the method changes.
quality.weaknesses: The query/retrieve loop is drawn with long curved crossing arrows between the index and the decoder, so direction is hard to follow; the query's origin inside the decoder is not drawn; no hidden-state vectors are shown, only labels.

insights.structure: The left two-thirds shows indexing (input token row at the bottom, three overlapping chunk rows, one Encoder, a purple 'Index of one long input' bar on top) and the right third shows one Decoder Layer frame with a blue Cross attention box; two green pills (query, Retrieved hidden states) bridge them.
insights.data: Tokens are letter cells a-f in yellow, chunks repeat overlapping tokens with the context-only tokens in dashed outline, and the index is a single wide rounded bar; no vectors or numbers are shown.
insights.emphasis: The retrieval loop is the only coloured link between halves: green labelled pills on curved arrows (kNN Search) run from the decoder's cross attention up to the index and back.
insights.flow: The left half reads bottom-up (input -> dotted arrows to chunks -> Encoder -> index); the right half connects by two long curved arrows forming a loop between Cross attention and the index.
insights.avoid: The query and retrieved-states arrows curve across each other near the index and the decoder layer is drawn as a near-empty frame, so the decoder side feels underspecified.

arrangement.units: unframed indexing pipeline on the left; one rounded frame for the Decoder Layer on the right
arrangement.inputs_as: a row of yellow letter-token cells labelled Input:
